verdict.rationale: dlt pipelines are written as Python code, so a user could version and review them with their own git tooling. That is a user-side workaround, not a dlt capability. The evidence documents run logging, auditability and monitoring, but never pipeline versioning, change review, or rollback to a prior pipeline version. Run logs are an adjacent feature and do not satisfy the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
